title: TVSM Mod Profile
description: A named mod profile stored at {modWorkDir}/profiles/{name}.json. Tracks BepInEx version, per-mod version selections with enabled flags, and a prepended snapshots array for rollback.

name.description: Profile name; matches the filename without the .json extension.

bepInExVersion.description: BepInEx version active in this profile. Profile-level (not per-mod); mixed BepInEx versions are not supported.

mods.description: Map of mod name to mod entry. BepInEx itself is tracked via bepInExVersion, not here.

snapshots.description: Prepended list of pre-mutation snapshots. Most recent is index 0. tvsm mod rollback pops index 0 and restores mods and bepInExVersion.

installLayout.description: How tvsm mod apply materialises this mod into the game environment.

enabled.description: false preserves the version pin without active linking; useful for temporarily disabling a mod without losing its version selection.

gameVersionRange.description: Semver range string (e.g. '>=0.45', '>=0.45 <1.0'). Out-of-range mods emit a warning at apply time unless --force is passed.

id.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the snapshot was created.
